items.title: 5.4 Wire ka Young's modulus tay karna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.4 with Fig. 5.4 (PDF 97-98).

blocks.text: Wire ki shakal mein kisi material ka Young's modulus tajurbe (experiment) se zyada tar Searle's apparatus se maloom kiya jata hai (Fig. 5.4).

Is mein ek hi material ki do wires hoti hain, lambai aur diameter dono barabar: ek auxiliary ya reference wire (muqable wali wire) aur ek test wire (jis par tajurba hota hai). Dono ek mazboot sahare (rigid support) se latakti hain. Neeche ke siron par dono horizontal bars (frames F₁ aur F₂) se juri hain. Reference wire ke frame ke hook par ek constant (fixed) weight aur test wire par hanger latkaya jata hai, taake wire tani rahe aur us mein bal (kinks) na hon.

blocks.alt: Ek support se do taar latakte hain: baen taraf reference taar CD aur daen taraf test taar AB. Har ek par lakri ka frame hai, baen F2 aur daen F1, jo cross bars se jure hain. Frames ke darmiyan spirit level F1 par lage micrometer screw par tika hai. Frames ke neeche hooks par baen taraf constant weight slab aur daen taraf slotted weights wala bhari hanger latakta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.4: Searle ka apparatus (kitab ki Figure 5.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Wire ka Young's modulus tajurbe se maloom karne ka tareeqa yeh hai:

items: Metre scale se wire ki ibtidai (initial) lambai L₀ napein.
Screw gauge se wire ka diameter d napein. Wire ke kai mukhtalif jagahon par nap kar average lein.
Micrometer ghuma kar spirit level ko bilkul horizontal karein. Micrometer ki yeh reading reference reading ke taur par likh lein.
Test wire par mazeed weight dalein; test wire lambi hoti hai to spirit level jhuk (tilt ho) jata hai.
Micrometer screw ghuma kar spirit level ko dobara horizontal karein. Doosri reading mein se pehli reading nikalein; yeh test wire ki extension (lambai mein izafa) hai.
In formulas se stress aur strain nikalein:

blocks.text_alt: Stress = Weight / Area of wire = F/A = mg/πr²
Strain = ΔL/L₀ = Change in length / Original length

blocks.title: Brain Teaser!
blocks.text: Steel ki rod aur rubber band par barabar force lagai jaye to kaun zyada khinchega?

blocks.prompt: Brain Teaser ka jawab: steel ki rod aur rubber band par barabar force lage to kaun zyada khinchega? Aur physics ke hisaab se zyada elastic kaun hai?
blocks.explanation: Rubber band kahin zyada khinchega, kyun ke us ka Young's modulus steel se bohat kam hai (steel ka Table 5.1 mein 200 × 10⁹ N m⁻²). Physics mein elasticity ka matlab hai asal shakal mein wapas aane ki salahiyat, aur jis material ko thora sa strain dene ke liye bhi bohat stress chahiye (bara Y) woh zyada elastic kehlata hai; is liye steel zyada elastic hai.

blocks.text: 7. Test wire par weight barha kar oopar wale steps dohrayein, taake stress aur strain ki mazeed values milein.
8. In values se stress-strain graph banayein; yeh seedhi lakeer (straight line) honi chahiye. Phir is lakeer ka slope Y nikalein. Yeh slope wire ke Young's modulus ke barabar hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek hi material ki do wires kyun li jati hain, aur extension metre scale ke bajaye micrometer se kyun napi jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Reference wire par bhi test wire jaisa garmi se phailao aur sahare ka jhukao hota hai; dono ka muqabla karne se yeh asar khatam ho jata hai aur sirf dale gaye weight ki extension bachti hai. Extension millimetre se bhi kam hoti hai, jo metre scale se theek nahi napi ja sakti, jabke micrometer 0.01 mm tak parhta hai.

items: Searle's apparatus: ek hi material aur diameter ki reference aur test wires, frames, spirit level aur micrometer.
L₀ (metre scale) aur d (screw gauge, average) napein; level seedha kar ke reading; weight dalein, dobara seedha kar ke reading; farq = extension.
Stress = mg/πr², strain = ΔL/L₀; kai values le kar stress-strain graph; seedhi lakeer ka slope = Y.
